Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This is a technical methodology study focused on the development and validation of a 3D-printer-based fraction collector. The primary comparison is between a 2D fractionation workflow (case) and a single-shot LC-MS/MS workflow (control) to evaluate proteome coverage and sample recovery. There are no biological perturbations (e.g., drugs, genetic edits) applied to the samples to drive the comparison; the variable is the analytical separation method.
